name: project-switch-starts-the-other-folders-own-session
description: Switching to another project folder restarts the session in that folder with that folder's own conversation: a folder never used before starts fresh, and switching back resumes the first folder's conversation. Each folder keeps its own transcript history.
reason: Every project folder is its own conversation. Resuming one folder's session id in another folder would mix two unrelated pieces of work in one conversation.
source: DESIGN.md v2.1 B 'Multiple conversations (several folders)'; AppState.switchProject(to:), AppState.adoptProject

script.reason: Launch resumes the first folder's conversation.
A folder with no conversation yet starts fresh.
Back to the first folder: its own conversation resumes, not the one just used.

transcript.text: Earlier conversation restored — New Session starts clean.
